verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an agent and workflow framework, but the evidence never documents a cron, schedule, or recurring trigger for workflows. The workflow docs cover typed steps, retries, branches, and suspend/resume, which are one-off orchestration rather than recurring execution. Polling events routed into notification signals (mastra-docs-16) are an adjacent event-subscription feature, not job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
